issue_context.title: When removing integration "Sky Connect USB" from Raspberry Pi it keeps trying to find it.
issue_context.body:
### The problem

Hi,

As the title suggest: I disabled the Home Assistant Sky Connect integration. Then removed the USB stick from the Pi. And then deleted the integration. Rebooted. But in the log this keeps popping up:

```
Logger: homeassistant.config_entries
Source: config_entries.py:412
First occurred: 18:25:46 (1 occurrences)
Last logged: 18:25:46

Config entry 'Home Assistant Sky Connect' for homeassistant_sky_connect integration not ready yet: None; Retrying in background
```

### What version of Home Assistant Core has the issue?

2022.12.1

### What was the last working version of Home Assistant Core?

2022.12.1

### What type of installation are you running?

Home Assistant OS

### Integration causing the issue

New Sky Connect USB stick from Nabu Casa

### Link to integration documentation on our website

_No response_

### Diagnostics information

_No response_

### Example YAML snippet

```yaml
Config flow
```


### Anything in the logs that might be useful for us?

_No response_

### Additional information

Reboot doesn't help. I don't have anything to remove because allready removed it, so nothing I can do about it.

@balloob Seems important error about new Sky Connect product. Anyone interested? If not I can close my case...

What you have removed is the ZHA config entry; the `homeassistant_sky_connect` config entry is still there.
It's not nice that there are never ending warnings when the USB stick is removed, we should maybe let the config entry either disable itself, or remove itself, if the USB stick is not plugged in, or lower the log severity from warning to debug or info.
The solution in #84975 was not working well and has been reverted

review_comments:
I don't think that we should convert this to async just because 1 call needs to have a scan included. 

Instead, we should create a 2nd function `async_check_is_plugged_in` that does a scan + returns `asnyc_is_plugged_in`.

I don't agree, `async_is_plugged_in` was added specifically for sky_connect, and is not used by anything else.
Without waiting for a scan, `async_is_plugged_in` unconditionally returns `False` during Home Assistant startup which makes the function useless.

Right, but I suggest to make a wrapper function that does scan + is_plugged_in, so we could keep is_plugged_in the same for places like `hardware.async_info`, which is now turning async as a side-effect.
It's strange that we notify listeners of a successful entry load when it didn't actually succeed. Should this be `False`?
I guess they would have to restart if they plug it in after startup?
@emontnemery why not spawn a task to unload the config entry instead? Then we also don't have to turn `async_info` into an async method.
If we unload the config entry if the dongle is not plugged in when Home Assistant starts, who is then loading the config entry if the dongle is plugged in again?

That's essentially the same as https://github.com/home-assistant/core/pull/84975, although that PR *disabled* the config entry during setup and *enabled* it during discovery.
It's not a reliable solution, because the task unloading the config entry will race against it being loaded from the config flow.

@bdraco suggested adding a new optional function `async_is_present` to components, which will avoid unloading or disabling the config entry from a task:

```diff
diff --git a/homeassistant/components/homeassistant_sky_connect/__init__.py b/homeassistant/components/homeassistant_sky_connect/__init__.py
index 4315862e52..15b20b0af2 100644
--- a/homeassistant/components/homeassistant_sky_connect/__init__.py
+++ b/homeassistant/components/homeassistant_sky_connect/__init__.py
@@ -112,3 +112,8 @@ async def async_setup_entry(hass: HomeAssistant, entry: ConfigEntry) -> bool:
 async def async_unload_entry(hass: HomeAssistant, entry: ConfigEntry) -> bool:
     """Unload a config entry."""
     return True
+
+
+async def async_is_present(hass: HomeAssistant) -> bool:
+    """Return True if the Sky Connect is present."""
+    return True
\ No newline at end of file
diff --git a/homeassistant/config_entries.py b/homeassistant/config_entries.py
index 2907b6a966..1208dec45d 100644
--- a/homeassistant/config_entries.py
+++ b/homeassistant/config_entries.py
@@ -379,6 +379,11 @@ class ConfigEntry:
 
         error_reason = None
 
+        if hasattr(component,"async_is_present"):
+            present = await component.async_is_present(hass, self)
+            if not present:
+                do not load
+
         try:
             result = await component.async_setup_entry(hass, self)
```
